thought.text:
Tenang, errornya jelas sekarang.

## Penyebabnya

```
litellm.BadRequestError: LLM Provider NOT provided.
You passed model=deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored
Pass model as E.g. completion(model='huggingface/starcoder')
```

**OpenHands butuh prefix provider.** Tapi **bukan** `openai/` — itu yang tadi saya sarankan dan salah.

Yang benar: **`openai/` memang prefix yang tepat**, tapi nomask harus menerima model tanpa prefix. Jadi harus dipisah.

Saya tes dulu kombinasi yang benar.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && K="nmk_live_g1r1I3MMlZDJaclmlAFylupkQulRriMVhSaVx3xR"; echo "=== litellm prefix openai/ -> kirim ke nomask apa? ==="; for m in "openai/deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored" "hosted_vllm/deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored"; do printf "%-55s " "$m"; curl -s --max-time 60 -X POST "https://api.nomask.ai/v1/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"model\":\"$m\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"hi\"}],\"max_tokens\":30}" -w "[%{http_code}]" | head -c 120; echo; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && K=\"nmk_live_g1r1I3MMlZDJaclmlAFylupkQulRriMVhSaVx3xR\"; echo \"=== litellm prefix openai/ -> kirim ke nomask apa? ===\"; for m in \"openai/deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored\" \"hosted_vllm/deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored\"; do printf \"%-55s \" \"$m\"; curl -s --max-time 60 -X POST \"https://api.nomask.ai/v1/chat/completions\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $K\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d \"{\\\"model\\\":\\\"$m\\\",\\\"messages\\\":[{\\\"role\\\":\\\"user\\\",\\\"content\\\":\\\"hi\\\"}],\\\"max_tokens\\\":30}\" -w \"[%{http_code}]\" | head -c 120; echo; done", "summary": "Test litellm provider prefixes", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "timeout": 200}
